name: web-security
title: Web application and infrastructure security
summary: Build and run the product so it resists attack: threat modeling, vulnerability classes, browser security headers, secrets and cryptographic choices, the software supply chain, hardening of company accounts and admin tools, security logging and breach response, and security testing.
useWhen: Is this feature secure? What could an attacker do with it?
Add a Content Security Policy, fix a CORS error or set security headers
A secret or API key was committed or leaked
Where should secrets live and how do I rotate them?
Which primitive fits here: a random token, a hash, an HMAC, encryption or a signature?
Harden our admin panel, staff accounts and SaaS logins before launch
A dependency was compromised or has a critical vulnerability
We think we have been breached; what do we do now?
Prepare for a penetration test or set up a vulnerability disclosure policy
Render user-supplied HTML, markdown, SVG or URLs safely
